messages:
maria-sales: Morning team — POC with Acme Health. They need audit logs retained for 13 months across the POC and confirmation about whether prompts/responses can be captured. Also asking for scoped API keys for evaluation and whether we can do Dedicated pool trial + later VPC peering for Private. Can someone confirm what we can offer and ETA?

alex-presales: Hi! Quick summary: Hosted API — metadata logs (request id, model, token counts, client IP, timestamps) available by default. Prompt/response capture is not enabled by default for Hosted; we can enable expanded capture for a POC under NDA and with retention controls.

alex-presales: Dedicated trial — we can provision a reserved pool for the POC; full instance logs are available and we can enable request/response capture for the trial environment (again under agreement). Private/VPC — customer controls logging entirely; we provide guidance + KMS integration.

sam-eng: For Dedicated provisioning I need: customer org name, expected sustained qps, peak bursts, models, and preferred region. ETA is ~48–72 hours from ticket acceptance (subject to infra availability). We'll also need firewall/VPC CIDR for peering.

tariq-security: Security note: we can retain logs up to 13 months for enterprise POCs if covered by contract terms. Prompt/response retention requires explicit approval and must be scoped (who can read them, where stored). For PHI/health data we require a DPA + DPIA signoff and redaction plan. We support CMK (customer-managed KMS) for Private; Hosted/Dedicated CMK is available as an enterprise add-on.

alex-presales: Action items: 1) maria to collect org name + qps + models + CIDR (if they want VPC). 2) Tariq to send the minimal SQA/DPA checklist for POC prompt capture. 3) I'll open the provisioning ticket and attach a sample scoped API key config.

maria-sales: Got it. Org: Acme Health. Sustained qps: 5, bursts up to 20. Model requested: redwood-3-small. They explicitly want prompt retention for quality checks during the POC — said they will sign whatever addendum needed.

tariq-security: We can enable prompt retention for the POC to a segregated audit bucket with CMK and access logging. Require the DPA + a short one-page statement of intended use and retention. I'll draft the statement and the minimum controls (RBAC, admin SSO, no public access).

provisioner-bot: provisioner: Dedicated trial requested by alex-presales for Acme Health. Ticket created: PROV-4521. Status: pending intake.

sam-eng: I'll pick up PROV-4521 once intake is complete. When we need VPC peering details I'll ask for the peer CIDR and any allowed IPs. Planning note: provisioning will include a temporary API key scoped to the POC pool and a separate audit bucket.

alex-presales: Example scoped API key payload for POC (example only): `{"scopes":["inference:generate"], "allowed_models":["redwood-3-small"], "max_qps":20}` — we'll issue this to Acme for test calls and rotate after POC.

maria-sales: Perfect — I'll send the checklist and DPA request to the customer now and update PROV-4521 with their answers. Thanks everyone. :+1:
